en_title: Valve May Be Working on an OLED Steam Frame, According to Datamined Source Code
cn_title: 代码暗示Valve或正开发OLED头显
subtitle: 更清晰，也更贵？
opus_summary: 源代码挖掘发现，Valve可能正在开发OLED版Steam Frame，单眼分辨率或大幅提高。消息尚未证实，即使属实，新型号恐怕也要等很久才会推出。

paragraphs.en: The Steam Frame came out a month ago, and while it's one of the best PCVR headsets out there, its lenses weren't quite as high-quality as some of its competitors. However, it seems like Valve might be working on a mid-generation refresh with OLED optics.
paragraphs.cn: Steam Frame发售已有一个月。虽然它是目前最出色的PCVR头显之一，但镜片品质还不及部分竞品。不过，Valve似乎可能正在开发采用OLED光学组件的中期升级版。

paragraphs.en: According to SteamFrameHub , which dug through some of the source code for the Steam Frame kernel, the OS has references to a different Steam Frame with OLED optics, code named 'Plano.' Take this with a massive grain of salt, of course. But if it's real, the Plano headset would have largely the same specs as the existing Steam Frame, just with OLED panels with a per-eye resolution of 3,552x3,840, compared to the 2,160x2,160 pancake lenses found in the Steam Frame.
paragraphs.cn: SteamFrameHub挖掘了部分Steam Frame内核源代码，称操作系统中提到了另一款采用OLED光学组件的Steam Frame，代号为「Plano」。当然，这条消息远未得到证实，务必谨慎看待。但如果消息属实，Plano头显的规格将与现有Steam Frame大致相同，只是改用了单眼分辨率为3,552×3,840的OLED面板；现款Steam Frame则采用分辨率为2,160×2,160的Pancake镜片。

paragraphs.en: A higher-resolution OLED display would do wonders for the Steam Frame, especially for anyone using it for PCVR, rather than trying to play standalone games. Those better lenses would come a much higher price, though; as SteamFrameHub notes, the leaked optic specs line up nicely with the lenses found in the Samsung Galaxy XR headset, which starts for around $1,799. However, that headset launched before the RAM crisis kicked off, so a Steam Frame that matched its specs would likely be at least a bit more expensive.
paragraphs.cn: 分辨率更高的OLED显示屏将大幅改善Steam Frame的体验，尤其是对用它连接PC玩VR游戏、而非以独立模式运行游戏的玩家而言。不过，更好的镜片也会带来高得多的价格。SteamFrameHub指出，泄露的光学规格与三星Galaxy XR头显所用镜片的规格相当吻合，后者起售价约为1,799美元(约合人民币1万元)。然而，那款头显在内存危机爆发前就已推出，因此，规格相当的Steam Frame很可能至少还要再贵一些。

paragraphs.en: Just like the rest of Valve's hardware this year, the Steam Frame was supposed to kick off a new era of accessible PC hardware, fueled by SteamOS at its center. However, because of an ongoing RAM crisis that won't be ending any time soon, the impact has been greatly diminished. Still, there are at least some people who seem to be buying the Steam Frame and the Steam Machine, as they're both still completely sold out at the time of writing.
paragraphs.cn: 与Valve今年的其他硬件一样，Steam Frame原本应以SteamOS为核心，开启一个PC硬件更易入手的新时代。然而，内存危机仍在持续，短期内也不会结束，让这些硬件的影响力大打折扣。不过，至少似乎还是有一些人在购买Steam Frame和Steam Machine，因为截至本文撰写时，两款产品依然全部售罄。

paragraphs.en: Because Valve is still working on getting through the reservation list and waitlist for the Steam Fame, it's safe to assume that even if a Steam Frame OLED is a thing that will actually exist, it probably won't come out for quite a long time. The real question then, is whether or not that'll happen before Valve finds the perfect chipset that'll make the company want to make a Steam Deck 2 . Just like with everything else Valve, we'll simply have to wait and see.
paragraphs.cn: Valve还在处理Steam Frame的预约和候补名单，因此可以合理推测，即便Steam Frame OLED确实会成为现实，恐怕也要过很久才会推出。那么，真正的问题就是：它会不会赶在Valve找到理想芯片组、决定开发Steam Deck 2之前问世？和Valve的其他事情一样，我们只能拭目以待。
